Produce tracked docs/implementation/reliability-plan.md with actual source/merged/dirty evidence, comparison of existing experiment observations, ordered bounded fixes and acceptance contracts. No graphics or native host launch; read-only existing raw evidence and bounded CPU inspection allowed. No application code changes/merge/push in this preparation ticket. Fresh independent critique required before implementation. Return first leaf proposal with exact files, preconditions, tests and source-artifact provenance; never overwrite retained experiments.
